module.name: BNK Cert Issuer
module.description: Creates Forge-managed self-signed CA and ClusterIssuer resources for BNK cert-manager flows.

required.reason: Cert-manager CRDs must exist before ClusterIssuer/Certificate resources can be created

optional.name: namespace
optional.description: Namespace where cert-manager resources are managed

optional.name: self_signed_cluster_issuer_name
optional.description: Name of the bootstrap self-signed ClusterIssuer

optional.name: ca_certificate_name
optional.description: Name of the CA Certificate resource

optional.name: ca_secret_name
optional.description: Secret name that stores the generated CA keypair

optional.name: cluster_issuer_name
optional.description: Name of the CA-backed ClusterIssuer for BNK components

optional.name: ca_renew_before
optional.description: Renewal window before CA certificate expiry

key_outputs.name: cluster_issuer_name
key_outputs.description: CA-backed ClusterIssuer name for BNK components

key_outputs.name: cert_issuer_ready
key_outputs.description: Whether the issuer chain is ready
